title: Writing Task 1 - Bar Chart: Internet Usage
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a bar chart showing internet usage across different age groups.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Internet Usage by Age Group
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The bar chart below shows the percentage of people in different age groups who used the internet daily in 2010 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data summary: In 2010, internet usage was 95% (16-24), 82% (25-34), 65% (35-44), 48% (45-54), 30% (55-64), 15% (65+). In 2020, internet usage was 99% (16-24), 97% (25-34), 93% (35-44), 88% (45-54), 78% (55-64), 54% (65+).

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the bar chart showing internet usage by age group in 2010 and 2020.

keyFeatures: Internet usage increased across all age groups between 2010 and 2020
The biggest increase was among the 65+ group (from 15% to 54%)
The 16-24 age group had the highest usage in both years
The gap between youngest and oldest groups narrowed from 80% to 45%
